usedFor: Data teams use Databricks to start compute with “Create Cluster” and organise code with “Create a Repo”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Order Created” in Lemon Squeezy, then “Create Cluster” in Databricks
bestTemplate.why: A new order starts a cluster, so processing is ready without anyone opening the workspace.

watchOut: “Delete a Job” deletes a job by ID, so double check the ID before it runs.
